title: As elections near, South Sudan risks new atrocity crimes, warns rights probe

title: Five years after Taliban takeover, Afghan women ‘erased from public life’
content: Five years after the Taliban seized power, women and girls in Afghanistan have been systematically stripped of their rights, UN agencies said on Wednesday. De facto authorities have issued more than 100 decrees curbing education, work and freedom of movement – restrictions now compounded by deep cuts to aid on the ground.
